title: Research: flag-43 head-step repair co-hosts at update 3364 with no added channel mass (no new kappa)
body:
## Change and scope

Bounded follow-up under priority revision 6, card `p104-side-correction`. [#3456](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/3456) shows that on present-head flag 43 (`X21` → `Y59`, head `15`) no published `Y59` update co-hosts the basis head. This package answers its open repair question with a concrete changed schedule **R0** and an exact channel bill.

**R0.** Keep every published event in order with the same ADDs and coefficients. Retarget nine transports of `Y59`, `D17`, `Y103` and `D28` (each changed frame = published frame plus `15`). Then event 3364 (`Y59 += D17/4`) — the ADD that settles `Y59`'s final `X21` coefficient `1/2` — runs in chart `[95,447,6,32,20,15]` while `X21` is still live. The published `check_native.validate()` passes on the repaired word (eight native edges swapped for eight newly lowered ones; 280 framed rows, 72 dirty-helper restorations, 208 endpoint adapters hold).

**Bill.** Events (4,058), ADDs (2,624), transport occurrences (1,410), rank mass (2,368) and distinct native edges (740) are unchanged. Paid profile delta `-3H1 + 5H2 - H3 - H4`. Published ranks of the changed transports majorize the repaired ranks, so the delta is ≤ 0 under any convex per-rank price and exactly 0 under any affine one. Under a strictly concave per-rank price the same profile delta can be positive; that case is left symbolic.

**Obstruction (same class).** Among repairs that keep event order and ADDs, keep endpoint frames and add no rank mass (inserted refinements allowed), 14 of 15 `Y59` updates are blocked; only 3364 is admissible and it forces exactly the four registers above. Comparison schedule **R1** (reorder + one rank-1 lift) also validates natively at +1 transport.

**Scoped repair bill. No new kappa.** Selected κ stays 0.001672660197076918. Does not reprint drop/arrive chronologies of #3456/#3451/#3443. Does not supply the `I − G/2` side correction (still open).

## Result

## Validation

```sh
python3.12 -I -B research/p104-flag43-head-step-repair/verify.py
python3.12 -I -O -Werror -B research/p104-flag43-head-step-repair/verify.py
python3.12 -I -O -Werror -B research/p104-flag43-head-step-repair/independent.py
python3.12 -I -O -Werror -B research/p104-flag43-head-step-repair/test_package.py
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/p104-flag43-head-step-repair
```

Expected:

```text
PASS_P104_FLAG43_HEAD_STEP_REPAIR flag=43 head=15 repaired_update=3364 added_events=0 added_adds=0 added_transports=0 added_rank_mass=0 retargeted_transports=9 forced_registers=4 profile_delta=-3H1+5H2-H3-H4 native_validate=PASS earlier_updates_obstructed=14/14 no_new_kappa
PASS_P104_FLAG43_HEAD_STEP_REPAIR_INDEPENDENT … rows_equal=280/280 earlier_updates_obstructed=14/14 no_new_kappa
PASS_P104_FLAG43_HEAD_STEP_REPAIR_TESTS cases=14 clean_read_only=1 scanners=2
PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE research/p104-flag43-head-step-repair outcome=completed
```

Default verify is read-only. Admission uses `need()` and still fires under `-O`.

## Overlap and credit

Closest prior: [#3456](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/3456) (flag 43 published obstruction; this answers its repair OQ). Cites [#3451](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/3451)/[#3443](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/3443)/[#3392](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/3392)/[#3349](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/3349) only. Soft-overlap checked against open [#3363](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/3363) (relay census / coefficient convention reused; event-level delivery split recomputed only for co-hosting). Does not reopen #3441/#3436/#3421/#3411, deferred peeled-leaf/rho=0/V45, or the merged readout series through #2883.
